fields.name: frame_latency_max
fields.doc: Acquiring a back buffer blocks until the present from this many frames ago is displayed. 1 gives the lowest latency, 0 disables the wait. Ignored when the platform cannot report presentation.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Must not be negative. Must be a multiple of the format's block extent.

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: Zero components select the rest of the mip. Must be a multiple of the format's block extent unless it reaches the edge of the mip.

fields.name: row_pitch_bytes
fields.doc: Distance between rows of blocks in the buffer, 0 is tightly packed. Must be a multiple of the format's block size.

fields.name: slice_pitch_bytes
fields.doc: Distance between depth slices or layers in the buffer, 0 is tightly packed. Must be a multiple of the row pitch.

functions.name: scCopyTextureToBuffer

functions.name: scSetScissor
functions.doc: Only valid inside a render pass. Beginning a render pass resets the scissor to the full render target.

functions.name: scSetViewport

params.name: viewport
params.doc: Width and height must be positive. Depths must be in [0, 1].

functions.doc: Only valid inside a render pass. Beginning a render pass resets the viewport to the full render target with a [0, 1] depth range.
